IBBA Players

Source: R/ibba.R
ibba_players.Rd

The roster of a team-season: jersey, names, position, height and birth date.

Endpoint: GET https://basket.co.il/ws/ws.asmx/Players

Usage

ibba_players(team_id, team_uid, season)

Arguments

team_id

(integer required): Team-season id (new every season; Maccabi = 1109 in 2025-26): team_id in ibba_teams, ibba_games home_team_id / away_team_id or ibba_box_score.

team_uid

(integer required): IBBA club id, stable across seasons (Maccabi Tel Aviv = 10; team_uid in ibba_teams). Use 0 for all clubs only where the route says so.

season

(integer required): Season END year (2026 = 2025-26); sent to the host as cYear unchanged.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerPlayer-season id (key space: IBBA player registrations; a NEW id every season, e.g. Jaylen Hoard = 21912 in 2025-26 and 25997 in 2026-27; the ASMX host has no cross-season person id). Joins ibba_players, ibba_player, ibba_box_score and ibba_leaders; null on the team-credited and TOTAL box rows.
jerseycharacterJersey number as a zero-padded string ('02'); a box score also uses '_TEAM' and 'TOTAL' for its two non-player lines.
seasonintegerSeason END year as an integer (2026 = 2025-26): the host's own cYear, no mapping.
team_idintegerTeam-season id (key space: IBBA team registrations; a NEW id every season for the same club, e.g. Maccabi Tel Aviv = 1109 in 2025-26 and 2111 in 2026-27). Joins ibba_teams, ibba_players, ibba_coaches, ibba_box_score and the games' home / away ids.
player_name_hecharacterPlayer name in Hebrew, HTML-unescaped.
player_namecharacterPlayer name in English, HTML-unescaped.
is_replacedlogicalTrue when the person was replaced during the season (left the roster or staff).
is_locallogicalTrue for an Israeli (local) player; the isr_ leader categories count only these.
photo_pathcharacterSite-relative path of the photo (team or player picture); prefix with https://www.basket.co.il.
height_mdoubleHeight in metres (1.93).
position_hecharacterPosition in Hebrew.
positioncharacterPosition code: PG, G, G-F, F, F-C or C.
birth_dateDateDate of birth (public player bio); null when not published.

Details

The IBBA wrappers read the Israel Basketball Association's ASP.NET web service at basket.co.il/ws/ws.asmx (the ops its own site calls): seasons, boards, teams, rosters, coaches, schedules and results, box scores from 2004-05, season stats and leaders of the Winner League (Israeli Premier League). They mirror sdv-py's sportsdataverse.basketball.ibba wrappers of the same names: same arguments, the same snake_case columns and types, one row per sdv-py row. The live box score, play-by-play and shot coordinates of a game are in the ibba_segev_game_info() family (Segev Stats).

Unofficial and unsupported. The web service is keyless, unofficial and reverse engineered. Requests are spaced at least one second apart per host (429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried three times; an HTTP 500 is the host's deterministic error page, a stack trace, and is not retried); keep crawls slow and incremental. Contact details (e-mail, phone, fax) and coaches' dates of birth are dropped.

Seasons and ids. season is the END year and the host's own cYear (2026 = 2025-26): it is sent unchanged. team_id and player_id are per-SEASON registrations (Maccabi Tel Aviv = team 1109 in 2025-26, 2111 in 2026-27); the host has no cross-season person id (the stable player key is the Segev player id of the ibba_segev_*() family). team_uid is the stable club id (Maccabi = 10). A 0 means "all" where an argument says so; every parameter of an op is always sent.

Coverage. League box scores from 2004-05 (season = 2005). external_id and segev_game_id exist only from 2025-26 (earlier games carry no Segev id, so segev_game_id is NA). The women's league and Liga Leumit are NOT on this host. Every value on the wire is a string and Hebrew text is HTML-entity encoded: ids, counts and dates are cast and text is unescaped.

Errors are classed conditions, never a warning plus an empty frame: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, an empty body, which is what an unknown id answers, or an empty row list), hoopR_bad_request (HTTP 400 / 422, or an argument that is not a non-negative integer, a boolean or a non-empty string as the op needs) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other failure: another status, a transport error, a body that is not JSON, an error or changed envelope, a row for another season, team, player, board or game, or a box score of a game that is not final). All inherit hoopR_error.

See also

Other IBBA: ibba_boards(), ibba_boards_ex(), ibba_box_score(), ibba_coaches(), ibba_configuration(), ibba_games(), ibba_games_by_team(), ibba_games_ex(), ibba_leaders(), ibba_player(), ibba_player_stats(), ibba_segev_game_crosswalk(), ibba_stats_types(), ibba_team(), ibba_team_stats(), ibba_teams()
